notes: «وَ قَضَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي أَهْلِ اَلْبَوَادِي» names no transmitter: the Imam is only «عليه السلام» (a pronoun), so there is no name to write.

A ruling case («قضى ... في», no transmitter, rule 11). The previous reports open with «قضى رسول الله» and a chain of Ibn Mahbub's report; nothing in this text names the Imam, so no name is taken over.
